BROE auctioneers is pleased to present 22 Monksfield Lawns to the market. This stunning 4-bedroom end-of-terrace plus attic conversion is located in one of the most sought-after areas in Clondalkin. The property has been maintained to an impeccable standard and offers an excellent opportunity for those looking for more space to grow their family or to establish themselves close to Clondalkin Village. The property is conveniently located to multiple bus routes, M50/N7 Motorways, and The Red Cow Luas line, which can be reached within a two-minute drive. The interior living space is bright and airy throughout the house. Upon entering you'll find a bright entrance hallway that leads to a spacious lounge and modern kitchen that includes marble worktops. On the ground floor, there is also a guest WC. The first floor features four well-proportioned bedrooms and revamped family bathroom. Additionally, the property boasts a stunning low-maintenance landscaped garden. This property is likely to generate a lot of interest, so early viewing is highly recommended. 

Contact Craig Leap of BROE auctioneers to register your interest today.
